C0701.title: Using Ticket-Snatching Software to Buy Sanxingdui Museum Tickets and Scalp Them at Inflated Prices
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C0701.summary: Starting in October 2023, Zheng and others used ticket-snatching software to automatically secure Sanxingdui Museum tickets and resold them at marked-up prices of 100 to 150 yuan. The group obtained over 2,300 tickets and made tens of thousands of yuan in illegal profits.
